title: Invoke endpoints must bind caller-supplied trace_ids to the authorized experiment before any side effect
answers: user runs issue detection on traces from an experiment they cannot read
genai evaluation scores traces belonging to another experiment
foreign trace id accepted by invoke endpoint and job queued
broken object authorization on trace_ids in evaluate or issue invoke
body:
Symptom: A user who can edit their own experiment starts issue detection or a GenAI evaluation over traces from an experiment they cannot read, and the results are written into their own run.
Root cause: mlflow/server/handlers.py:_invoke_issue_detection_handler and _invoke_genai_evaluate_handler were gated only by the route validator (validate_can_update_experiment) on request experiment_id; caller trace_ids were never checked against that experiment.
Fix pattern: Call mlflow/server/handlers.py:_validate_trace_ids_in_experiment(store, trace_ids, experiment_id) before credential fetch, scorer resolution, or run creation. It raises PERMISSION_DENIED (generic message) if any existing trace has a different experiment_id.
Constraints: Missing traces are intentionally not rejected by the helper; they fail later in the job. Do not scope the batch lookup by experiment_ids, since that hides foreign traces and makes the check vacuous. The fallback runs only on MlflowNotImplementedException or NotImplementedError; a store implementing neither lookup must fail closed (error propagates). Keep the call ahead of any run or job creation so a rejected request leaves no run and no job.
applies: Any handler that accepts trace_ids together with an experiment_id for background processing; does not cover read-only trace routes, which have their own checks.
says: Users can run evaluation jobs against trace data from experiments they cannot access.
Issue detection runs successfully on foreign traces belonging to unauthorized experiments.
Prevent automated evaluations from analyzing and recording traces across unauthorized experiment boundaries.
Model evaluation reports include trace results pulled from private experiments.
Block issue analysis jobs when submitted trace identifiers belong to another workspace experiment.
search: Handlers accepting trace_ids and experiment_id for background processing must call _validate_trace_ids_in_experiment in mlflow/server/handlers.py before credential fetching, scorer resolution, or run creation. The helper raises PERMISSION_DENIED if any trace belongs to a different experiment_id, while missing traces are intentionally deferred to fail later in the job. Batch lookups must not be scoped by experiment_ids, and tracking stores implementing neither lookup must fail closed on NotImplementedError or MlflowNotImplementedException. Covers _invoke_issue_detection_handler, _invoke_genai_evaluate_handler, and _invoke_scorer_handler, but excludes read-only trace routes.
